title: Small - I mean it is not very wide at all.  Great for undergarments, hand towels, face towels.
text:
Small - I mean it is not very wide at all. Great for undergarments, hand towels, face towels.. First the pros: extremely well constructed. Looks and feels like it will last forever.

Now the con: It's small; when I say small I mean it is not wide at all. You can't even dry a woman's medium tee on it without it because even the narrow way - the shirt will not have enough room to lay flat. The pic is deceiving.

I gave this 3 stars instead of 2 because I can think of a couple of perfect uses for it:
1. For a petite woman living in an apartment - perfect for her to hang her undies, lacy garments (that's not to say it won't handle something heavier; it's just not that wide), wash clothes, hand towels; and
2. For a pool area to hang swimsuits to dry.
For these two purposes this item will be perfect.
